results.final_sql: WITH current_lines AS ( SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0483'), 0) / SUM(line_paid_amount) AS fraction_of_paid_dollars FROM current_lines

WITH primary_sub AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class, MIN(submission_date) AS first_submission_date FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), paid AS ( SELECT p.payer_class, date_diff('day', p.first_submission_date, r.payment_date) AS days_to_pay FROM primary_sub p JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication AND r.paid_amount > 0 ) SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS paid_claims, ROUND(MEDIAN(days_to_pay), 1) AS median_days_to_pay, ROUND(quantile_cont(days_to_pay, 0.9), 1) AS p90_days_to_pay FROM paid GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

WITH denied AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND is_denied ), codes AS ( SELECT a.carc_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.claim_key || '|' || a.payer_key) AS denied_pairs FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN denied d USING (claim_key, payer_key) WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'CO' AND a.is_denial_carc GROUP BY a.carc_code ) SELECT carc_code, denied_pairs FROM codes ORDER BY denied_pairs DESC, carc_code LIMIT 5

WITH events AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) AS payer_class, COUNT(*) AS n_events, BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current, BOOL_OR(is_denied) AS any_denied FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ) SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS remitted_pairs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events = 1 AND has_current AND NOT any_denied) AS first_pass_pairs, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE n_events = 1 AND has_current AND NOT any_denied) / COUNT(*), 2) AS first_pass_rate_pct FROM events GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

WITH pairs AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, any_value(payer_class) AS payer_class, COUNT(DISTINCT check_or_eft_number) AS trace_count, BOOL_OR(is_reversal) AS has_reversal, BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication) AS has_current, COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_current_adjudication), 0) AS current_paid FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), multi AS (SELECT * FROM pairs WHERE trace_count >= 2) SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS multi_trace_pairs, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE has_reversal) AS pairs_with_reversal, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE NOT has_current) AS pairs_without_current, ROUND(SUM(current_paid), 2) AS current_paid_amount FROM multi GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

WITH current_lines AS ( SELECT line_is_denied, claim_is_denied FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS partial_denied_lines FROM current_lines WHERE line_is_denied AND NOT claim_is_denied

WITH primary_payers AS ( SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' ), deductible AS ( SELECT a.adjustment_amount FROM sem.adjustments a JOIN primary_payers p USING (claim_key, payer_key) WHERE a.is_current_adjudication AND a.group_code = 'PR' AND a.carc_code = '1' ) SELECT ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(adjustment_amount), 0), 2) AS primary_deductible FROM deductible

WITH latest AS ( SELECT service_month, referring_npi FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission AND service_month >= DATE '2026-06-01' ), by_npi AS ( SELECT service_month, referring_npi, COUNT(*) AS claims FROM latest GROUP BY 1, 2 ), ranked AS ( SELECT service_month, claims, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY service_month ORDER BY claims DESC, referring_npi ASC) AS rn FROM by_npi ), top5 AS ( SELECT service_month, SUM(claims) AS top5_claims FROM ranked WHERE rn <= 5 GROUP BY service_month ), totals AS ( SELECT service_month, COUNT(*) AS total_claims FROM latest GROUP BY service_month ) SELECT t.service_month, t.total_claims, top5.top5_claims, ROUND(100.0 * top5.top5_claims / t.total_claims, 1) AS top5_share_pct FROM totals t JOIN top5 USING (service_month) ORDER BY t.service_month

WITH current_lines AS ( SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '87798'), 0) / SUM(line_paid_amount) AS fraction_of_paid_dollars FROM current_lines

WITH adj AS ( SELECT claim_key, claim_payer_key, is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication ), cpt AS ( SELECT DISTINCT claim_key, procedure_code FROM sem.claim_lines WHERE is_latest_submission ) SELECT c.procedure_code, COUNT(DISTINCT a.claim_payer_key) FILTER (WHERE a.is_denied) * 1.0 / COUNT(DISTINCT a.claim_payer_key) AS denial_rate, COUNT(DISTINCT a.claim_payer_key) AS adjudications FROM adj a JOIN cpt c USING (claim_key) GROUP BY c.procedure_code HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT a.claim_payer_key) >= 20

WITH latest AS ( SELECT claim_key, line_count, charge_amount FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission ), primary_payer AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), joined AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN l.line_count = 1 THEN '1' WHEN l.line_count = 2 THEN '2' ELSE '3+' END AS bucket, l.charge_amount, r.is_denied FROM latest l JOIN primary_payer p USING (claim_key) JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication ) SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS claims, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied_claims, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) / COUNT(*), 2) AS denial_rate_pct, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(charge_amount) FILTER (WHERE is_denied), 0), 2) AS denied_billed_charge FROM joined GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY bucket

WITH fb AS ( SELECT provider_adjustment_id, payer_key, reference_id, payment_date, provider_adjustment_amount FROM sem.provider_adjustments WHERE plb_reason_code = 'FB' ), carry AS ( SELECT * FROM fb WHERE provider_adjustment_amount < 0 ), matched AS ( SELECT c.reference_id, c.payment_date AS carry_date, c.provider_adjustment_amount, o.payment_date AS offset_date, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY c.provider_adjustment_id ORDER BY o.payment_date, o.provider_adjustment_id) AS rn FROM carry c LEFT JOIN fb o ON o.payer_key = c.payer_key AND o.reference_id = c.reference_id AND o.provider_adjustment_amount = -c.provider_adjustment_amount AND o.payment_date > c.payment_date ) SELECT reference_id, carry_date, ROUND(-provider_adjustment_amount, 2) AS amount_carried_forward, offset_date, date_diff('day', carry_date, offset_date) AS days_between FROM matched WHERE rn = 1 ORDER BY carry_date, reference_id

WITH cur AS ( SELECT payer_class, payment_month, paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND payment_month IN (DATE '2026-07-01', DATE '2026-08-01') ), agg AS ( SELECT payer_class, SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-07-01') AS jul_paid, SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_month = DATE '2026-08-01') AS aug_paid FROM cur GROUP BY payer_class ), tot AS (SELECT SUM(jul_paid) AS jul_tot, SUM(aug_paid) AS aug_tot FROM agg) SELECT a.payer_class, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(a.jul_paid, 0) / NULLIF(t.jul_tot, 0), 1) AS july_share_pct, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(a.aug_paid, 0) / NULLIF(t.aug_tot, 0), 1) AS august_share_pct, ROUND(100.0 * COALESCE(a.aug_paid, 0) / NULLIF(t.aug_tot, 0) - 100.0 * COALESCE(a.jul_paid, 0) / NULLIF(t.jul_tot, 0), 1) AS change_pp FROM agg a CROSS JOIN tot t ORDER BY a.payer_class

WITH repl AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS repl_date FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' AND frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), orig AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS orig_date FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' AND frequency_code = '1' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), base AS ( SELECT r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.repl_date, o.orig_date, date_diff('day', o.orig_date, r.repl_date) AS days_to_repl FROM repl r LEFT JOIN orig o USING (claim_key, payer_key) ), with_pay AS ( SELECT b.claim_key, b.days_to_repl, b.orig_date, b.repl_date, rc.payment_date, rc.paid_amount FROM base b LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims rc ON rc.claim_key = b.claim_key AND rc.payer_key = b.payer_key AND rc.is_current_adjudication AND rc.payment_date >= b.repl_date ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS corrected_claims, ROUND(AVG(days_to_repl), 2) AS avg_days_original_to_replacement, COUNT(payment_date) AS paid_on_or_after_replacement, ROUND(AVG(date_diff('day', orig_date, payment_date)) FILTER (WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL), 2) AS avg_days_original_to_payment, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE payment_date IS NOT NULL), 0), 2) AS total_paid FROM with_pay

WITH voids AS ( SELECT claim_key, MIN(submission_date) AS void_date FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '8' GROUP BY claim_key ), flags AS ( SELECT v.claim_key, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = v.claim_key AND r.paid_amount > 0 AND r.payment_date < v.void_date ) AS paid_before, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = v.claim_key AND r.is_reversal AND r.payment_date >= v.void_date ) AS reversed_after, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(r.paid_amount) FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = v.claim_key AND r.is_current_adjudication ), 0) AS current_paid FROM voids v ) SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM voids) AS voided_claims, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN paid_before THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS paid_before_void, COALESCE(SUM(CASE WHEN reversed_after THEN 1 ELSE 0 END), 0) AS reversed_on_or_after_void, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(current_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid FROM flags
SELECT COUNT(*) AS zero_paid_not_denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication AND paid_amount = 0 AND NOT is_denied

WITH repl AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class, MIN(submission_date) AS repl_date FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), resp AS ( SELECT r.payer_class, r.claim_key, r.payer_key, MIN(date_diff('day', r.repl_date, e.payment_date)) AS days FROM repl r JOIN sem.remit_claims e ON e.claim_key = r.claim_key AND e.payer_key = r.payer_key AND e.payment_date >= r.repl_date GROUP BY r.payer_class, r.claim_key, r.payer_key ) SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS corrected_claims, ROUND(AVG(days), 1) AS avg_days, MIN(days) AS min_days, MAX(days) AS max_days FROM resp GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

WITH pairs AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key FROM sem.remit_claims GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key HAVING BOOL_OR(is_reversal) AND NOT BOOL_OR(is_current_adjudication) ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS reversed_without_current FROM pairs

WITH current_lines AS ( SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '80307'), 0) / SUM(line_paid_amount) AS fraction_of_paid_dollars FROM current_lines

WITH prim AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(payer_class) AS payer_class, MIN(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), cohort AS ( SELECT * FROM prim WHERE first_sub BETWEEN DATE '2026-07-01' AND DATE '2026-07-31' ), first_remit AS ( SELECT c.payer_class, c.claim_key, c.first_sub, MIN(r.payment_date) AS first_pay FROM cohort c LEFT JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = c.claim_key AND r.payer_key = c.payer_key GROUP BY c.payer_class, c.claim_key, c.first_sub ) SELECT payer_class, COUNT(*) AS cohort_claims, COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE first_pay IS NOT NULL AND date_diff('day', first_sub, first_pay) <= 14 ) AS remitted_within_14, ROUND(100.0 * COUNT(*) FILTER ( WHERE first_pay IS NOT NULL AND date_diff('day', first_sub, first_pay) <= 14 ) / COUNT(*), 1) AS share_pct FROM first_remit GROUP BY payer_class ORDER BY payer_class

WITH current_lines AS ( SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0482'), 0) / SUM(line_paid_amount) AS fraction_of_paid_dollars FROM current_lines

WITH repl AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS repl_date FROM sem.claims WHERE frequency_code = '7' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), prior_denial AS ( SELECT r.claim_key, r.payer_key, r.repl_date FROM repl r WHERE EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims d WHERE d.claim_key = r.claim_key AND d.payer_key = r.payer_key AND d.is_denied_recorded AND d.payment_date < r.repl_date ) ), later AS ( SELECT p.claim_key, p.payer_key, EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims e WHERE e.claim_key = p.claim_key AND e.payer_key = p.payer_key AND e.payment_date >= p.repl_date ) AS has_later, ( SELECT c.is_denied FROM sem.remit_claims c WHERE c.claim_key = p.claim_key AND c.payer_key = p.payer_key AND c.is_current_adjudication ) AS current_denied, COALESCE(( SELECT c.paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims c WHERE c.claim_key = p.claim_key AND c.payer_key = p.payer_key AND c.is_current_adjudication ), 0) AS current_paid FROM prior_denial p ), classed AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN has_later AND current_denied IS NOT NULL AND NOT current_denied THEN 'overturned' WHEN has_later THEN 'denied again' ELSE 'no remit since correction' END AS outcome, current_paid FROM later ), outcomes AS ( SELECT * FROM (VALUES ('denied again'), ('no remit since correction'), ('overturned')) v(outcome) ) SELECT o.outcome, COALESCE(COUNT(c.outcome), 0) AS claims, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(c.current_paid), 0), 2) AS current_paid FROM outcomes o LEFT JOIN classed c ON c.outcome = o.outcome GROUP BY o.outcome ORDER BY o.outcome

WITH overturned AS ( SELECT c.claim_key, c.payer_key, c.paid_amount FROM sem.remit_claims c WHERE c.is_current_adjudication AND NOT c.is_denied AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims e WHERE e.claim_key = c.claim_key AND e.payer_key = c.payer_key AND e.adjudication_state = 'superseded' AND NOT e.is_reversal AND e.is_denied ) ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS overturned_pairs, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(paid_amount), 0), 2) AS current_paid FROM overturned

WITH latest AS ( SELECT claim_key, charge_amount, frequency_code FROM sem.claims WHERE is_latest_submission ), prim AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, MIN(submission_date) AS first_sub FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' GROUP BY claim_key, payer_key ), open_ar AS ( SELECT l.charge_amount, date_diff('day', p.first_sub, DATE '2026-08-14') AS age_days FROM latest l JOIN prim p USING (claim_key) WHERE l.frequency_code IS DISTINCT FROM '8' AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication ) ), bucketed AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN age_days <= 14 THEN '0-14' WHEN age_days <= 29 THEN '15-29' ELSE '30+' END AS bucket, charge_amount FROM open_ar ) SELECT bucket, COUNT(*) AS claims, ROUND(SUM(charge_amount), 2) AS billed_charge FROM bucketed GROUP BY bucket ORDER BY CASE bucket WHEN '0-14' THEN 1 WHEN '15-29' THEN 2 ELSE 3 END

WITH first_sub AS ( SELECT claim_key, MIN(submission_date) AS first_dt FROM sem.claims GROUP BY claim_key ) SELECT COUNT(*) AS never_remitted FROM first_sub f WHERE f.first_dt >= DATE '2026-07-01' AND f.first_dt < DATE '2026-08-01' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM sem.remit_claims r WHERE r.claim_key = f.claim_key)

results.final_sql: WITH lines AS ( SELECT payer_key, payer_name, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication AND NOT line_is_denied AND units_paid = 1 AND line_allowed_amount > 0 ), freq AS ( SELECT payer_key, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount AS allowed, COUNT(*) AS n, any_value(payer_name) AS payer_name FROM lines GROUP BY payer_key, procedure_code, line_allowed_amount ), ranked AS ( SELECT payer_key, payer_name, procedure_code, allowed AS typical_allowed, ROW_NUMBER() OVER ( PARTITION BY payer_key, procedure_code ORDER BY n DESC, allowed DESC) AS rn FROM freq ), typical AS ( SELECT payer_key, payer_name, procedure_code, typical_allowed FROM ranked WHERE rn = 1 ), joined AS ( SELECT t.payer_name, l.line_allowed_amount, t.typical_allowed FROM lines l JOIN typical t USING (payer_key, procedure_code) ) SELECT payer_name, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE line_allowed_amount < typical_allowed) AS underpaid_lines, ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(typical_allowed - line_allowed_amount) FILTER (WHERE line_allowed_amount < typical_allowed), 0), 2) AS shortfall FROM joined GROUP BY payer_name ORDER BY shortfall DESC, payer_name

WITH current_lines AS ( SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = 'G0480'), 0) / SUM(line_paid_amount) AS fraction_of_paid_dollars FROM current_lines

WITH monthly AS ( SELECT payer_class, payment_month, COUNT(*) AS adjudications, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) AS denied FROM sem.remit_claims WHERE is_current_adjudication GROUP BY payer_class, payment_month ), rated AS ( SELECT payer_class, payment_month, adjudications, denied, denied * 1.0 / adjudications AS rate, LAG(denied * 1.0 / adjudications) OVER (PARTITION BY payer_class ORDER BY payment_month) AS prev_rate FROM monthly ) SELECT payer_class, strftime(payment_month, '%Y-%m') AS payment_month, adjudications, denied, ROUND(100.0 * rate, 2) AS denial_rate_pct, ROUND(100.0 * (rate - prev_rate), 2) AS mom_change_pp FROM rated ORDER BY payer_class, payment_month

WITH current_lines AS ( SELECT procedure_code, line_paid_amount FROM sem.remit_lines WHERE is_current_adjudication ) SELECT COALESCE(SUM(line_paid_amount) FILTER (WHERE procedure_code = '81479'), 0) / SUM(line_paid_amount) AS fraction_of_paid_dollars FROM current_lines

WITH prim_sub AS ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, referring_npi FROM ( SELECT claim_key, payer_key, referring_npi, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY claim_key ORDER BY submission_date DESC, claim_id DESC) AS rn FROM sem.claims WHERE payer_responsibility = 'P' ) t WHERE rn = 1 ), adj AS ( SELECT p.referring_npi, r.is_denied FROM prim_sub p JOIN sem.remit_claims r ON r.claim_key = p.claim_key AND r.payer_key = p.payer_key AND r.is_current_adjudication WHERE p.referring_npi IS NOT NULL ) SELECT referring_npi, COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE is_denied) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS denial_rate, COUNT(*) AS claims FROM adj GROUP BY referring_npi HAVING COUNT(*) >= 15 ORDER BY denial_rate DESC, referring_npi LIMIT 5
